$comment: A rule usable in QDT profiles to make conditional deployment. Rules are evaluated by python-rule-engine (https://github.com/santalvarez/python-rule-engine): this schema follows its models.
title: Deployment rule
description: A rule contains a set of conditions, evaluated against the deployment context (environment variables, operating system, user, date...). The profile is deployed only if all its rules are satisfied.

name.title: Name
name.description: A way of naming the rule, to identify it in logs and reports. It should be unique within the profile, but it has no impact on the evaluation.

description.title: Rule description for human
description.description: What the rule checks, in a human readable form.

extra.title: Extra metadata
extra.description: Additional metadata, not used by the evaluation.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Root of the rule conditions: exactly one of all, any or not. The all operator requires every contained condition to be truthy; any requires at least one; not inverts the contained condition.

multiCondition.title: Multi condition
multiCondition.description: A group of conditions combined with exactly one of all, any or not. It can contain simple conditions and other multi conditions.

conditionArray.title: Condition array
conditionArray.description: A non-empty array of simple conditions or multi conditions.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: Compares the value found at path in the deployment context with value, using operator. Without path, the whole context is compared.

path.title: Path
path.description: JSONPath expression (jsonpath-ng syntax) to the value to compare, in the deployment context. Run `qdt export-rules-context` to see the available values.

operator.title: Operator
operator.description: Compares the value found at path with value. If the result is truthy, the condition passes.

oneOf.title: the context value must equal value
the context value must not equal value
the context value must be greater than value
the context value must be greater than or equal to value
the context value must be less than value
the context value must be less than or equal to value
the context value must be included in value (an array)
the context value must not be included in value (an array)
the context value (an array or a string) must include value
the context value (an array or a string) must not include value

value.title: Value
value.description: The value the context value is compared to. Any JSON value, null included.

params.title: Parameters
params.description: Additional parameters given to the operator.
